title: Nenu Ani Palikaavaa – Ashakiran Pallikonda Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: విన వినగ బోధపడే మ్రొక్కెద ఈ పూట.
1. నిన్నా, నేడు, రేపూ నీవు ఏకరీతిగానే ఉన్నావు.
బ్రతికేను ఉసరవెల్లినై — క్షమించి, మన్నించుము; ఇవే నా ప్రార్థనలు.
నీ దేవుడే నా దైవం అని అన్న రూతులు
పేరు పెట్టి పిలిచి రమ్మని రక్షణ ఇంటికి తెచ్చావు.
శతాధిపతి కున్న నేమాట చాలు అనే విశ్వాసం-
english: Vina vinagaa bodhapade mrokkeda ee poota
Ninnaa, nedu, repu neevu ekareethigaane unnaavu
Nee devude naa daivam ani anna Ruthulu
Peru petti pilichi rammani rakshana intiki techchaavu
Shataadhipatiki unna ne maata chaalu ane vishvaasam
translation: Every knee bows and praises You.
Even the hardest stone can be broken.
Have mercy, forgive, and protect me.
Did You say, “I am here”?
Will You reveal Yourself as “I alone”?
Make me alive by dwelling within me.
You are the tireless breath within me,
As I listen, I understand—so I bow and pray now.
Verse 1
You are the same yesterday, today, and forever.
I have lived like one who wandered—
Forgive me, pardon me; these are my prayers.
“Your people shall be my people,
Your God shall be my God” (like Ruth said).
I have no one, no one at all—
Please do not reject me.
I plead and cry out to You.
Verse 2
I have seen enough—
You saw Zacchaeus.
In the crowd, no one expected it,
But You called him by name and brought salvation to his house.
Like the centurion who believed
That just one word from You is enough—
You gave life even to his servant/son.
Defeat will not come near me,
My victory is in You alone.
O King, You are my refuge.
intro: Nenu Ani Palikaavaa is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Ashakiran Pallikonda and music composed by Anand Piano Lover. This song was released on March 19, 2026, through ashakiran pallikonda YouTube Channel.
